grammar.summary: 本课以「正义自动伸张」为线索，集中运用了被动语态、时间状语从句与过去完成时，并出现 must have done 表示对过去的推测。重点体会叙事中如何用被动语态突出「小偷被卡住、被解救」，用从句交代事件先后，用过去完成时交代先于解救发生的事。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: 当要突出动作的承受者时用被动语态：be + 过去分词。本课大量使用被动叙述「正义被伸张、奖惩被实施、小偷被抓住、被移交」，主语多为承受者，使叙述客观。

examples.en: Reward or punishment are meted out quite independent of human interference.
examples.cn: 奖惩的实施是不受人意志支配的。

examples.en: When a thief was caught on the premises of large jewellery store on morning, the shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right.'
examples.cn: 一天上午，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店里被人抓住的时候，店员一定会忍不住说：“他罪有应得。”

examples.en: Justice had been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.cn: 甚至在那人还没被送交给警察之前，正义就已得到了伸张。

points.title: 时间状语从句 (Time Adverbial Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 when/after/as/before 引导时间状语从句，交代动作先后。本课用 when 引出「被抓住时」，用 before 强调「正义在移交前已伸张」，用 after 交代「凿穿墙后」，层次清晰。

examples.en: When a thief was caught on the premises of large jewellery store on morning, the shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right.'
examples.cn: 一天上午，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店里被人抓住的时候，店员一定会忍不住说：“他罪有应得。”

examples.en: After chipping through a wall which was eighteen inches thick, they found that a man had been trapped in the chimney.
examples.cn: 他们凿透了18英寸厚的墙壁，发现有个人卡在烟囱里。

examples.en: Justice had been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.cn: 甚至在那人还没被送交给警察之前，正义就已得到了伸张。

points.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect)
points.explanation: 过去完成时 (had + 过去分词) 表示「先于过去某动作发生」的动作。本课中「被困烟囱」先于「被解救」，「企图行窃」先于「被抓住」，故用 had been trapped / had tried。

examples.en: After chipping through a wall which was eighteen inches thick, they found that a man had been trapped in the chimney.
examples.cn: 他们凿透了18英寸厚的墙壁，发现有个人卡在烟囱里。

examples.en: The sorry-looking, blackened figure that emerged, admitted at once that he had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney.
examples.cn: 那个看来满脸沮丧、浑身漆黑的家伙从烟囱里一出来，就承认头天夜里他企图到店里行窍，但让烟囱卡住了。

exercises.q: Reward or punishment ______ out quite independent of human interference.
After chipping through a wall which was eighteen inches thick, they found that a man ______ in the chimney.
Justice had been done even before the man ______ over to the police.
下列哪个词与课文中 emerge 的含义最接近？
用被动语态填空：The sorry-looking, blackened figure that emerged, admitted at once that he ______ ______ (try) to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney.（写出 try 的正确完整形式，两个词）
